## Summary

Explain the user-visible change and why it matters.

## Scope

Files/behaviour modified, and anything intentionally out of scope.

## Verification

- [ ] \`npm test\` passed (or explanation)
- [ ] \`npm run export\` and SVG verification passed when relevant
- [ ] Browser GIF test or real-profile screenshots reviewed for visual changes
- [ ] Both worlds and light/dark checked when artwork changes
- [ ] GraphQL totals and REST public decorations remain separate
- [ ] Synthetic vs real provenance is correctly labelled
- [ ] No credentials, private metadata or copyrighted unlicensed assets
- [ ] README/AGENTS/docs updated if relevant

## Screenshots / artefacts

Add actual rendered before/after images at profile width, not just full-size browser screenshots.

## Known limitations and follow-ups

State remaining risks clearly. Do not claim unrun tests as passing.
